Financial Services

Office of The Treasurer

Room: 208, Floor: 1, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Office of the Treasurer of Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT) is responsible for the overall financial management and fiscal oversight of the university. The office ensures proper budgeting, financial planning, revenue management, and expenditure control in accordance with institutional policies and regulatory requirements. It supervises accounts, audits, financial reporting, and compliance to maintain transparency and accountability. Through effective financial governance and resource management, the Treasurer’s Office supports the sustainable growth, operational efficiency, and long-term development of BUBT.

Services of Our Office

Judicious Cash Reserve Investments

Ensures surplus funds are invested prudently in low-risk and approved instruments to preserve capital while generating stable returns.

Efficient Debt and Liquidity Management Techniques

Maintains an optimal balance between assets and liabilities to meet short-term obligations while minimizing borrowing costs and financial risk.

Long-Term Financial Stability

Focuses on sustainable financial planning and forecasting to support the university’s operational and strategic goals over time.

Effective Use of Financial Resources to Promote Student Services and Educational Initiatives

Allocates funds strategically to enhance academic programs, student support services, infrastructure, and institutional development.

Proactive Measures Against Inflation and Monetary Depreciation

Implements forward-looking financial strategies to mitigate the impact of inflation and currency depreciation on institutional assets.

Effective Application of Government VAT and Tax Strategies

Ensures full compliance with applicable VAT and tax regulations while optimizing fiscal efficiency through lawful planning and reporting.
